title: Glowing island with a palm tree
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffe066' stop-opacity='1'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffb300' stop-opacity='0.85'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id='sand' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffd98a'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#e0a63c'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='trunk' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='0'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#a8702a'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#d99a44'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='leaf' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#3ddc84'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#0fa86a'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='leaf2' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#5ef0a0'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#1ecf82'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <radialGradient id='coconut' cx='35%' cy='35%' r='70%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#c97a3a'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#7a4418'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='sun' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#fff7b0'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffd63d'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- sun -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='22' r='11' fill='url(#sun)'/>

  <!-- island -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='82' rx='40' ry='13' fill='url(#sand)'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='80' rx='40' ry='11' fill='#ffd98a' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- palm trunk curved -->
  <path d='M52 78 C50 65 46 52 42 38 L48 37 C52 50 56 64 59 78 Z' fill='url(#trunk)'/>
  <path d='M52 78 C50 65 46 52 42 38 L45 37.5 C48 51 53 65 55.5 78 Z' fill='#c98a3c' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- fronds -->
  <path d='M45 39 C30 34 20 40 12 50 C22 44 34 42 45 39 Z' fill='url(#leaf)'/>
  <path d='M45 39 C32 43 24 52 18 62 C28 54 38 47 45 39 Z' fill='url(#leaf2)'/>
  <path d='M45 39 C45 26 40 15 30 8 C38 18 42 28 45 39 Z' fill='url(#leaf)'/>
  <path d='M45 39 C52 28 60 20 72 16 C60 24 52 32 45 39 Z' fill='url(#leaf2)'/>
  <path d='M45 39 C58 38 70 42 80 50 C70 44 58 41 45 39 Z' fill='url(#leaf)'/>
  <path d='M45 39 C56 46 64 56 68 68 C60 57 52 48 45 39 Z' fill='url(#leaf2)'/>
  <path d='M45 39 C40 48 34 56 26 62 C35 55 41 47 45 39 Z' fill='url(#leaf2)' opacity='0.9'/>

  <!-- highlight on frond center -->
  <circle cx='45' cy='39' r='3' fill='#b6ffd9'/>

  <!-- coconuts -->
  <circle cx='49' cy='42' r='3.2' fill='url(#coconut)'/>
  <circle cx='54' cy='43' r='3' fill='url(#coconut)'/>
  <circle cx='51' cy='46.5' r='2.8' fill='url(#coconut)'/>

  <!-- little glow sparkles -->
  <circle cx='20' cy='30' r='1.4' fill='#fff3a0'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='30' r='1.2' fill='#fff3a0'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='55' r='1.3' fill='#fff3a0'/>
  <circle cx='24' cy='55' r='1.2' fill='#fff3a0'/>
</svg>
